corrections.detail: Google Art Project 4414x4568 and two photographs 3000x4000/4160x4552 all represent MNAC inventory 065579-000. Use one object record, photo variants as source files.
Alonso Cano 'Saint Agnes', Gemäldegalerie Berlin 414B, lost in World War II; reconstructed photos/copies do not constitute an extant clean high-res original.
Cabrera MUNAL photograph CC BY-SA 4.0: if cropped/transformed, attribution, change notice and license-compatible reproduction obligations apply.
Van Dyck Apostle Philip KHM Gemäldegalerie 9703; KHM permits personal download but directs scholarly/commercial publication to a reproduction request. Do not infer app permission.
Met 1978.517 vs NGA 1974.52.1 distinct paintings by La Tour. Keep separate physical painting IDs.
Kimbell AP2024.02 recovered autograph object; historical copies inherit their own object provenance, not Kimbell original attribution.

Dresden Gal.-Nr.683 attribution contested: other SKD-linked source descriptions state 'Jusepe de Ribera (Schüler oder Nachahmer?)'; dated 1641 in catalogue whereas a photograph says 1647. This image has an angel helping Agnes and is not a clean solo portrait; hold outside strict 3–4 portrait tally.
